dyingPins.label: Love has turned. I am not wanted in this.
I am bad, or only holdable if I get this right.
If I stay, I will be swallowed or hurt.
What this requires is already beyond me.
There is no ground I can trust.
I am alone in this, and I shouldn’t take up room.
If I don’t carry it, it won’t be made right.

managedPins.label: God helps those who help themselves.
I’ll abide after I finish this.
I don’t need anything right now.

strategiesByBody.control: Set the list down for ten minutes. See if the hand reaches.
strategiesByBody.fight: One sentence before the case: “I’m reading attack. One minute.”
strategiesByBody.flight: Stay in this room five minutes. Screen after.
strategiesByBody.freeze: Feel the chair. Unclamp the jaw. Do not solve.
strategiesByBody.collapse: Name one sensation, or say “I’m gone.” Do not interpret.
strategiesByBody.rest: Stay. Nothing to fix in the body.

strategiesByMind.present_narrowed: Drop the verdict for sixty seconds. Look at this year’s face.
strategiesByMind.time_travel: Come back to this room. If future: two columns, one action in 24 hours. If past: name the old broadcast.
strategiesByMind.blank: Do not interpret. Body first. One word after two breaths: here.

strategiesByPin.unloved: Look at this year’s face. Say: “This may be the old broadcast.”
strategiesByPin.unworthy: Do not argue your case. Stay in the room as you are.
strategiesByPin.unsafe: Stay one minute. Do not solve. Feel the chair.
strategiesByPin.not_enough: Two columns. One action in 24 hours. Fog is not a verdict.
strategiesByPin.no_trust: One honest sentence to Him. No second half. Wait.
strategiesByPin.alone: One honest sentence to Him. No second half. Wait.
strategiesByPin.must_carry: Name the sting without absorbing anyone else’s weather.
strategiesByPin.unknown_dying: Sit. Do not solve. Let one true sentence form.
strategiesByPin.in_control: Set the list down for ten minutes. Watch the hand reach.
strategiesByPin.earned_place: Receive one thing you did not provision.
strategiesByPin.better_than: Name the hidden second half (than whom). Drop the rank for sixty seconds.
strategiesByPin.mine_to_manage: Cross out what is not yours today. Say it out loud.
strategiesByPin.up_to_me: One task that is actually yours. The rest is not a moral.
strategiesByPin.proverb: Do the one small act that is yours. Stop before you feel ready. Let the unfinished part stay unfinished in front of Him.
strategiesByPin.abide_after: Sit one minute after the amen. No second half.
strategiesByPin.need_nothing: Name one true need in a single clause.
strategiesByPin.unknown_managed: Set the list down. Sit one minute.

onboarding.title: I Am Here
onboarding.body: Home is Spirit rising, body at rest, mind present and open. This app helps you notice when you have left, and take one step back.

onboarding.title: One breath. One sentence.
onboarding.body: You will tap where you are. If something is pinning you, you will name it. Then a short breath with a line of Scripture. No score. No streak.

onboarding.title: This is not for every kind of pain.
onboarding.body: If you are in danger now, or thinking of ending your life, this is not the tool. Use the stand-down screen or local help. In the US, call or text 988.

crisis.title: This app should stand down.
crisis.body: If you are in danger now, or thinking of ending your life, get human help. In the US, call or text 988. If you are unsafe in the room you are in, leave if you can and contact someone you trust.

pin.titleDying: What would hurt most if it were true?
pin.titleManaged: Which sentence is running the desk?
pin.followup: Which would you least want confirmed right now — by a person, by tomorrow, or by God?

strategy.honestyProverb: That sentence is not in Scripture. It is the desk talking.

end.text: Home is Spirit rising, body rest, mind present-open.

settings.about: I Am Here helps a person notice where they are — spirit, body, and mind — and take one step back toward home. It is a flashlight in a doorway.
